verdict.rationale: The only exit-related evidence is a line on the Executive Compensation page about representing founders in "buyouts, IPOs, company sales and departures," plus IP due diligence for acquisitions. That shows peripheral exit involvement, not a documented company-side M&A or IPO practice. Missing for 10: a dedicated M&A practice page, a dedicated public-offering/capital-markets page, company-side exit deal experience or examples, and independent corroboration.
